column1: # FS114-YB4 stage 2: the instance's twelve statements against FS114-Y5's record

column3: in a non-Siamese valid map two distinct tiles of one colour cannot both share a boundary arc of positive length with one tile (C114-EDGE-RAINBOW's non-Siamese form: each tile's edge-neighbours carry distinct colours)
in a non-Siamese pinwheel `t_{j+1} ⊂ B̄(p, 1) ∩ B̄(q_j, 1) ∖ B(q_{j+1}, 1)` (N5-PIN0's region, re-derived)

for a blade `t_{j+1}` whose clockwise edge `j` is shorter than 60°: every 5/6 tile bordering its counter-clockwise side `M_j` (from `q_j` to `w_{j+1}`) is one tile `μ_j`, and every 5/6 tile bordering the inside part of its clockwise side `L_j` is one tile of the other colour; so `w_{j+1} ∈ cl μ_j`
consecutive pocket colours differ, `m_j ≠ m_{j+1}`, unless `t_{j+2}`'s side `M_{j+1}` is a unit arc centred at `w_{j+1}` (exception E2)
outside E2 the tile bordering `t_{j+1}`'s side `M_j` also borders the whole inside part of `t_{j+2}`'s side `L_{j+1}` (`μ_j = Λ_{j+1}`)

at each centre `q_k`, outside E1 and E2: either (B) `α_k = 60°` and `μ_{k−1} ∋ q_k`, or (A) `t_{k+1}` borders the ring clockwise from `q_k` for `λ_k ∈ [α_k − 60°, 60°]`, the outside tile there has colour `k − 1`, and `α_{k−1} + α_k ≤ 180°`; so every cone is at most `120°`
outside E1 and E2, every pinwheel at radius `1 + ε` has cones `(x, 180° − x, x, 180° − x)` with `60° < x < 120°` (the family `P_x`)

no non-Siamese simple valid fragment containing a neighbourhood of `B̄(p, 1)` holds a pinwheel at `p` in which the tile across the outer edge of a 120° tile has a 60° cone — the alternating member `(120°, 60°, 120°, 60°)` included; radius `1 + ε`

in `P_x` (outside E2): `λ_k = α_k − 60°`, `v_{k+1} = e(φ_k + 60°)`, each `q_k` is a degree-4 vertex with exactly the tiles `O_k` (colour `k − 1`), `T_k` (`k`), `μ_k` (`m_k`), `t_{k+1}`; `μ_k` crosses the ring at `q_k`; `T_k`'s sector lies in `[φ_k − 90° + β_k, φ_k + 30°]`; the pocket colours alternate

no non-Siamese simple valid fragment containing a neighbourhood of `B̄(p, 1)` holds a pinwheel of the family `P_x` (`60° < x < 120°`), outside E2: `T_k` and `O_{k+1}`, both of colour `k`, border the pocket tile `μ_k` along `ω(v_{k+1})` from `q_k` and along `ω(q_k)` from `v_{k+1}`, both outward, and come within `√(1 − 2tt′) < 1`

**no non-Siamese simple valid fragment containing a neighbourhood of the closed unit disc about `p` holds a pinwheel at `p`**, except possibly under E1 (an edge at `p` of length exactly `60°`) or E2 (a blade's counter-clockwise side a unit arc centred at its clockwise edge end)
K1-PIN120 is closed at radius `1 + ε`: no member exists unless E2 holds at the blade two past the 120° tile
